title: Analyzing Bias in Swiss Federal Supreme Court Judgments Using Facebook’s Holistic Bias Dataset: Implications for Language Model Training

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting 'dispreferred' demographic descriptors from the Holistic Bias Dataset across 8 demographic axes (e.g., ability, body type, race/ethnicity, religion, gender), translating them into German, French, and Italian, and using a Binomial Significance Test to analyze their co-occurrence with legal judgment outcomes (approval vs. dismissal).

Employing attention visualization (via the transformers-interpret library) on a fine-tuned BERT-based language model to evaluate if specific individual text tokens (e.g., translations of 'victim' or 'entitled') disproportionately drive the model's classification toward specific legal predictions regardless of context.
